integrity: Self-contained analytical proof with separately replayable exact-rational finite-degree symbolic diagnostics; finite checks do not establish the infinite-dimensional claim. Primary-source public date checked independently from journal dates. Historical priority remains subject to outside evaluation.
scientific_limitations: Only a pair of two-dimensional reciprocal-feedback blocks, standard Gaussian block marginals, known positive definite constant diffusion covariance, C^2 block-local drifts with Gaussian L2 components and first derivatives. Does not address unknown diffusion, arbitrary block sizes, non-Gaussian invariant densities or estimation from samples.
title: Canonical-correlation rigidity for Gaussian stationary diffusions with two reciprocal feedback pairs
